column1: # CC-ORTHO-SWEEP-DE-JA F3 / D4: stored<TAB>accepted<TAB>source. The stored form is the one in the bank; the grader reads accepted variants only from here.
# Source is the Amtliches Regelwerk 2024 (WV = Wörterverzeichnis, rule = § 32(2) Variantenschreibungen; PDF page, printed page = PDF page - 2). Hunspell de_DE_frami agreed and is a CHECK only.
# Rows are the lemma's inflection set (geographisch*, phantastisch*), plus Porträts, the only Porträt form in the bank (Portrait was added in 2024).

# Left out: the 11 a~e pairs (Maerkte/Merkte, Saetze/Setzen are other words), names (Theresa, Hertha), a brand (Photoshop), and Panter/Spagetti, which the 2024 list strikes (Panther/Spaghetti are the only forms).
